scorecard.key_number: auto-tagging on, tracking managed in this account
scorecard.why: Auto-tagging is on, conversion tracking is managed by the account itself, and it owns its own conversion actions.

scorecard.key_number: 4 counted actions; 1 lead action counts every conversion
scorecard.why: 'Calls from website (60s+)' (PHONE_CALL_LEAD) counts MANY_PER_CLICK, and 2 call actions are counted side by side ('Phone call from ads (60s+)', 'Calls from website (60s+)'), so one caller can be counted more than once.
'Chat lead' is counted in the goal but recorded nothing between 2026-07-23 and 2026-10-20. The other 3 counted actions recorded conversions in the last 7 days, and none stopped.

scorecard.key_number: 6.7% of 'Booking form submit' lands at the edge of its 30-day window
scorecard.why: 82.6% of counted conversions arrive within a day and 90% by day 4, but bookings for installs take weeks: 6.7% arrive 21 to 30 days after the click, so the window probably drops some.
The account has no UPLOAD_CLICKS or UPLOAD_CALLS action, and both import summaries are empty.

scorecard.key_number: enhanced conversions off for leads and on the web tag
scorecard.why: Customer data terms are accepted, but enhanced conversions for leads is off although the booking software knows which leads closed, and 'Google Ads - Booking form' has enableEnhancedConversion off. Consent not checked: no EEA or UK visitors.

scorecard.why: The site's GTM-EXMPL12 matches the connected container. 'Chat lead' is counted, but its Google Ads tag sits only in the draft (Google Ads - Chat lead), so it never fires. The booking tag, the Conversion Linker and the account id are right.

scorecard.key_number: 1 key event with no events; form submits can count twice
scorecard.why: The live Google tag sends to G-EXAMPLE1 and GA4 is linked to this Ads account. 'test_event' (created 2026-06-11) fired nothing in 30 days, and enhanced measurement's form interactions run next to the custom generate_lead key event.

top_fixes.fix: Count 'Calls from website (60s+)' once per click
top_fixes.spend_steered: $11,850 a month on 5 campaigns with conversion-based bidding
top_fixes.evidence: conversion_action query: WEBSITE_CALL, PHONE_CALL_LEAD, MANY_PER_CLICK; 31 conversions in 30 days
top_fixes.who: do this in Google Ads (Goals, the action, Count: One). update_conversion_action has no counting field; the alternative is a new ONE_PER_CLICK action with create_conversion_action, then setting this one to secondary.

top_fixes.fix: Check whether one caller can fire both call actions
top_fixes.spend_steered: the same $11,850: 'Phone call from ads (60s+)', 'Calls from website (60s+)' are both counted
top_fixes.evidence: 'Phone call from ads (60s+)' AD_CALL 139 in 30 days; 'Calls from website (60s+)' WEBSITE_CALL 31 in 30 days
top_fixes.who: check with the call tracking setup. If one call can fire both, I can set the duplicate to secondary with update_conversion_action (primary_for_goal: false) after you confirm.

top_fixes.fix: Lengthen the 'Booking form submit' window from 30 to 90 days
top_fixes.spend_steered: the same $11,850: bookings feed every conversion-based campaign
top_fixes.evidence: conversion lag, 90 days: 6.7% of its conversions arrive 21 to 30 days after the click
top_fixes.who: I can do this now (update_conversion_action click_through_lookback_window_days: 90), after you confirm

top_fixes.who: do this in Google Ads (Goals, Settings) and in Tag Manager (the tag's Include user-provided data)

lag.advice: Leave out the last 4 days before judging a CPA or a change.

everything_else: 2 hidden actions are clutter: old Universal Analytics goals ('UA - Contact form (old)', 'UA - Call click (old)'). They still say include in conversions but record nothing.
Secondary actions record but don't count: 'Page view - thank you' (92 in 30 days) and 'GA4 session_start (imported)' (10,600). That is right: neither is a lead.
All 7 enabled campaigns use the account's goals (goal_config_level CUSTOMER); none has a custom goal.
Every counted action uses data-driven attribution. No campaign bids on value, so the default values of 0 do no harm.
Windows: every counted action uses 30 days; view-through is 1 day.

GA4 counts generate_lead ONCE_PER_EVENT, so a repeat submit counts twice. GA4 shows 74 generate_lead key events from google / cpc against 88 'Booking form submit' conversions in Ads, a 15.9% gap: different attribution, under the 30% line.
Unattributed GA4 sessions: (not set) and (data not available) are 6.8% of sessions, under 20%. Event data retention is 14 months.
